rules.note: Two rounds: an absolute majority of valid votes on the first Sunday of October, otherwise a run-off between the top two on the last Sunday of October. Four-year term with one consecutive re-election. A vacancy is filled by the Vice President.
Fixed four-year term, elected with the first round of the presidential election; Congress cannot be dissolved.
Every four years, alternately one third (27 seats; 2006, 2014, 2022) and two thirds (54 seats; 2002, 2010, 2018, 2026) of the Senate, for eight-year terms.
